question: In February 2012, what percentage of customers consumed more than 528.3?
actual_sql:
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE consumption > 528.3)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_customers_over_528_3,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE consumption > 528.3) AS customers_over_528_3,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers
FROM yearmonth
WHERE date = '201202';
